boundary.included: All source pages, titles, abstracts, author/affiliation text, introductions, mathematics, auxiliary and empirical material, acknowledgements, references and one-time metadata.
boundary.excluded: Only individually bound repeated page furniture. No body-only or selected-theorem cuts.
boundary.main_result_policy: Full manuscript is the intended numerator under each reviewed corrected principal-result contract; it is not an all-assertions equivalence claim.
boundary.image_caveat: L035 physical9,10,12,22 contain raster scientific diagrams with unextracted labels; physical22 has no extracted text at all and its oversized image is clipped by the page. N009 physical1 has an image-only journal title/logo. None is assigned zero scientific or textual cost. The main text coordinate is complete-document extractable text, not complete visible text. Private transcription sensitivities and unpriced graphic structure remain separate.

glyph_policy.rule: Use actual per-character PDF font and exact bound occurrence. Visually identify every C0, private-use and replacement glyph; also fix the directly observed LCIRCLE/LINE/LASY printable font misdecodings. Apply the same scan and rule to all replacement PDFs before any adopted comparison.
glyph_policy.brace_rule: Do not collapse a three-piece brace into one character; substitute each original piece by its Unicode bracket-piece counterpart.
glyph_policy.diagram_rule: Preserve each extracted line component and node as one visible-character counterpart. Nontext PDF paths and raster geometric structure have no invented character-equivalent cost.
glyph_policy.sensitivity: Report raw selected and calibrated selected five metrics under NFC and NFKC, plus full untrimmed extraction sensitivity. Normality and diagram substitutions may alter UTF8-byte/alphanumeric metrics; no metric invariance is assumed.

replacement_boundary: The actual full U plus six applications and all four complete required programs are assembled in topic_A_volume/six_application_assembly.json. They will be charged in full, with formal validation separate; the measurement protocol is not yet frozen.
